ai_news.title: SubQ Launches First Commercial Subquadratic LLM with 12 Million Token Context Window
ai_news.summary: Startup Subquadratic launched SubQ, the first commercially available LLM built on a fully subquadratic sparse attention architecture, departing from the standard transformer design. The model ships with a native 12-million-token context window and claims roughly one-fifth the cost of frontier models with up to 52x faster performance. The company raised $29 million in seed funding to bring the model to market.
ai_news.relevance: This is a potential paradigm shift away from quadratic-attention transformers, offering a scalable path to massive context windows at a fraction of current inference costs.

ai_news.title: GPT-5.5 Instant Becomes New Default Model for ChatGPT
ai_news.summary: OpenAI replaced its previous default model with GPT-5.5 Instant, rolling it out as the standard experience for ChatGPT users worldwide. The new default is optimized for speed and responsiveness while maintaining strong reasoning capabilities. The move signals OpenAI's continued push to improve everyday user experience alongside its more capable flagship models.
ai_news.relevance: As the model now serving the largest user base in consumer AI, GPT-5.5 Instant's capabilities and limitations will directly shape public perception and enterprise adoption of LLMs.

ai_news.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash Reaches General Availability, Delivers Frontier Intelligence at 4x Speed
ai_news.summary: Google's Gemini 3.5 Flash model is now generally available, offering frontier-level intelligence at four times the speed of comparable models and priced at $1.50/$9 per million tokens with a 1-million-token context window. The model targets production workloads that require both high capability and low latency. Its availability marks a significant step in making high-performance AI accessible at scale.
ai_news.relevance: Combining frontier-class reasoning with sub-second latency and a competitive price point makes Gemini 3.5 Flash a strong candidate for real-time agentic and enterprise AI applications.

ai_news.title: Google Unveils TurboQuant at ICLR 2026, Slashing LLM KV Cache Memory Overhead
ai_news.summary: Google researchers presented TurboQuant at ICLR 2026, an algorithm that significantly reduces the memory burden of the KV cache in large language models through a two-step process combining PolarQuant vector rotation and Quantized Johnson-Lindenstrauss compression. The technique targets one of the primary bottlenecks in long-context LLM inference. It has implications for both training efficiency and deployment cost at scale.
ai_news.relevance: KV cache memory is a major constraint on serving long-context models; TurboQuant's compression approach could substantially reduce GPU memory requirements and inference costs for production deployments.

ai_news.title: Meta Signs $100 Billion AMD Chip Agreement to Diversify AI Infrastructure
ai_news.summary: Meta announced a multiyear agreement to purchase up to $100 billion worth of AMD chips as part of a strategy to diversify its AI hardware supply chain beyond NVIDIA. The deal includes a performance-based warrant giving Meta the option to acquire up to 160 million shares of AMD common stock. The agreement represents one of the largest single AI hardware procurement deals ever announced.
ai_news.relevance: This deal accelerates AMD's competitive position in AI accelerator hardware and signals that hyperscalers are actively reducing dependency on any single chip supplier, reshaping the AI infrastructure market.

sfdc_news.title: Salesforce Reports Record Q1 FY2027 Results With AI Revenue Up 205% Year-Over-Year
sfdc_news.summary: Salesforce posted Q1 FY2027 revenue of $11.13 billion (beating estimates of $11.05B), with GAAP EPS up 52% year-over-year. AI product revenue surged 205% YoY, and Slack Model Context Protocol surpassed 1 million active users within six weeks of launch. The company raised its full-year FY27 revenue guidance midpoint to $45.9–$46.2 billion, up 11% YoY.
sfdc_news.relevance: Confirms Agentforce and AI investments are delivering measurable commercial returns, signaling accelerated product investment in agentic capabilities for CRM users.

sfdc_news.title: Braze Reports Q1 FY2027 Financial Results and Launches Granular Permissions and WhatsApp Template Builder
sfdc_news.summary: Braze released its fiscal Q1 2027 financial results after market close, alongside a wave of platform updates including granular user permissions, a native WhatsApp Template Builder for creating and submitting Meta-approved templates directly in Braze, and a new Messaging Diagnostics dashboard for troubleshooting send outcomes. The company also launched native Shopify catalog sync, pulling product tags, collections, and metafields into Braze for richer personalisation.
sfdc_news.relevance: Braze marketers gain new self-serve controls for WhatsApp campaigns and deeper Shopify data without custom integrations, reducing engineering dependency for e-commerce personalisation.

sfdc_news.title: Braze Launches BrazeAI Operator, Agent Console, and Creative Studio With Figma and Canva Integrations
sfdc_news.summary: Braze announced BrazeAI Operator, an in-dashboard AI assistant that lets marketers create campaigns, build custom agents, generate content, and troubleshoot workflows without deep technical expertise. BrazeAI Agent Console provides a centralised environment to build and deploy AI agents that generate content and adapt campaigns in real time. Braze Creative Studio — directly integrated with Figma and Canva — connects creative production with campaign execution in one place, and EU hosting was added for BrazeAI Decisioning Studio.
sfdc_news.relevance: Braze users can now build and manage agentic marketing workflows without engineering support, while EU-based brands gain compliant access to real-time decisioning with data residency in-region.

sfdc_news.title: Salesforce Summer '26 Release: Multi-Agent Orchestration and Slack-First Sales Now Available
sfdc_news.summary: Salesforce announced its Summer '26 release going live June 15, headlined by Multi-Agent Orchestration in Agentforce — enabling AI agents to collaborate as a unified team across complex end-to-end workflows. Slack First Sales embeds CRM context and Agentforce directly into sellers' Slack workflows. Additional highlights include Real-Time Offer Management for personalised promotions and Retail Execution Dashboards for Tableau Next.
sfdc_news.relevance: Salesforce customers and admins need to prepare for the June 15 go-live, as Multi-Agent Orchestration and Slack-embedded AI represent significant workflow changes for sales and service teams.

sfdc_news.title: Amplitude Introduces Agentic AI Analytics for AI-Native Product Teams
sfdc_news.summary: Amplitude launched Agent Analytics, a new analytics system bridging product analytics and LLM observability, enabling teams to measure AI agent quality at scale, trace failures across prompts, tools, and context windows, and tie agent performance directly to business outcomes such as retention and conversion. Separately, Amplitude enhanced its Slack integration so shared chart links now surface chart context, suggested questions, and a direct entry point to Global Agent conversations — letting teams ask follow-up questions via @Amplitude without leaving Slack.
sfdc_news.relevance: Product and data teams building AI-powered features can now use Amplitude as a unified observability and analytics layer across both traditional user behaviour and AI agent performance.

claude_news.title: Next Samsung AI Win May Come Through Claude Creator Anthropic
claude_news.summary: Samsung is in advanced discussions for a significant investment in Anthropic, which would deepen the integration of Claude AI into Samsung's device ecosystem. The partnership signals growing enterprise and consumer hardware adoption of Claude as a preferred on-device and cloud AI assistant. This follows a broader trend of major tech companies anchoring their AI strategies around Anthropic's models.
claude_news.relevance: A Samsung–Anthropic deal could bring Claude directly to hundreds of millions of Samsung devices worldwide, expanding its reach well beyond current API and web users.

claude_news.title: Anthropic Upgrades Claude With New Opus 4.8 Model — Here's What's New
claude_news.summary: Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8, its most powerful model yet, which outperforms OpenAI's GPT-5.5 and Google's Gemini 3.1 Pro on benchmarks for agentic coding, financial analysis, and computer use. The release also introduces Dynamic Workflows in Claude Code — a research preview that orchestrates hundreds of parallel subagents to tackle very large-scale problems. A faster, more affordable Fast Mode running at 2.5× speed and three times cheaper than previous generations is now available via the API and claude.ai.
claude_news.relevance: Users and developers can now access Anthropic's strongest and most cost-effective model to date, with major gains in coding, vision, and agentic task performance.

claude_news.title: Anthropic Drops New Claude Model as OpenAI IPO Race Heats Up
claude_news.summary: Anthropic's annualized revenue run rate hit $47 billion in May 2026, up from roughly $10 billion a year earlier, underscoring rapid commercial momentum. The company also closed a $65 billion Series H funding round led by Altimeter Capital, Sequoia, and others, pushing its valuation to $965 billion — surpassing OpenAI as the most valuable AI startup in the world. The news comes as competitive pressure intensifies ahead of a potential OpenAI IPO.
claude_news.relevance: Anthropic's explosive growth and near-trillion-dollar valuation signal long-term stability and continued heavy investment in Claude's capabilities and infrastructure.

claude_news.title: Anthropic's Code With Claude Showed Off Coding's Future — Whether You Like It or Not
claude_news.summary: Anthropic held its Code with Claude event, demonstrating how Claude Code and its Dynamic Workflows feature are reshaping software development by enabling AI to autonomously plan, write, and iterate on entire codebases. The event showcased real-world use cases where Claude operated as a near-autonomous software engineer, raising both excitement and concern about the future role of human developers. Industry observers noted it as a defining moment for agentic AI in professional software engineering.
claude_news.relevance: For developers and engineering teams, this event previews how Claude Code's agentic capabilities will fundamentally change how software is built at scale.

claude_news.title: Claude Mythos Preview
claude_news.summary: Anthropic published a limited preview of Claude Mythos, a highly capable research model that autonomously discovered thousands of zero-day vulnerabilities — including 27-year-old bugs in OpenBSD — without human guidance. Due to its unprecedented offensive security power, Anthropic deemed it too dangerous for general release and is restricting access exclusively to critical-infrastructure partners through Project Glasswing. The preview represents a significant milestone in autonomous AI security research.
claude_news.relevance: Mythos signals the outer frontier of what Claude-family models can do in high-stakes domains, and Anthropic's cautious rollout reflects its stated safety-first approach to powerful capabilities.
